text:
Elena Soto: Hey everyone :wave: — super excited to join Redwood Inference as an MLE on the serving runtime team. First day! Quick Qs: who should I ping for laptop MDM/okta help, and where do you usually hang out for lunches?
Marta Gonzalez: Welcome Elena!! :tada: Ping me for MDM stuff, I do new-hire setup. Lunch crew is usually #lunch-plans or the courtyard on Tuesdays.
Jeffrey Hsu: hi elena — tagging @Marta worked for me. Also FYI — if your laptop prompts for enrollment, click the "Enroll with Okta" link in the onboarding doc (link in #new-hires).
Elena Soto: thanks!! I'm seeing an MDM error when I try to enroll: "device not eligible". Anyone seen that?
Marta Gonzalez: hmm. Can you open terminal and run: `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output?
Elena Soto: ran it, got `No enrollment found`.
Kaushik Rao: if it's blank the devex bot should have triggered provisioning. @DevEx Bot, any logs for 2001234567?
DevEx Bot: Provisioning record found for elena.soto@redwood.ai — device claim created. Enrollment link sent at 2001234600. If you didn't receive it, check spam or run `open https://okta.redwood.ai/enroll`
Elena Soto: got the link now, enrollment went through — thanks!
Sophie Liu: welcome! quick tip: join the #inference-optimizations channel, we post quarterly perf summaries and weird kernel findings. Also what's one fun fact about you? :)
Elena Soto: fun fact — I bake sourdough and once taught a class on scoring loaves. Also coffee > tea.
Jeffrey Hsu: love that. We have a rogue baker on the infra team too. :bread:
Marta Gonzalez: FYI your desk badge will be ready tomorrow at reception. Welcome aboard again — we'll do a quick 1:1 intro at 3pm.
Elena Soto: perfect, see you then. Thanks all :smile:
